title: Biomass-based water purification: a simple and novel one-pot process for converting date palm mesh fibers into a valuable nanomagnetic composite for water treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00378K, Paper
Batool Vahedi Sarrygani, Fayezeh Samari, Fatemeh Sedaghati
A low cost magnetic date palm mesh fiber (MDPMF) biosorbent was synthesized for efficient removal of MB and MnO4− from water.
